reproduce.boundedComparison: Test at most eight ready parts per guard, retain per-part savepoints and post-read leases.
reproduce.criterion: Each consumer >=3x faster at injected 1ms/statement; first committed mapped part <10000ms.
reproduce.stop: Targets met in the bounded offline comparison; no add-press-to-map inference.
